description: Peligrosidad por inundación fluvial T=100 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wmts-snczi.idee.es. Waterfalls associated with river flood areas, corresponding to a scenario of high probability of flooding (return period of 100 years). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Dangerousness due to river flooding T=100" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMTS. The listing shows 2013-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
